The Data Systems Stack (data.openie.dev) [E/M/S · reported_j]

Separates 3 artifacts: (1) data.openie.dev's unmetered 10-axis map (1.26M cells + illustrative canvas), (2) DNULLMM1's 34-record mmap probe (0.325 us / 1.77 uJ M5 Max reported_j), and (3) BSL-1.1 JouleDB.

1/2 Exact scope of 0.325 us / 1.77 uJ:
- Measured over 40,000 read-only POSIX mmap probes into a static 34-record RAM-cached DNULLMM1 table (Apache-2.0 in deterministic-null) — NOT SQL joins, MVCC, NVMe misses, or WAL fsync
- Cites Idreos (2018) & Harizopoulos (2009) [S]

2/2 Candid JouleDB license & missing baselines:
- JouleDB (openIE-dev/jouledb) is BSL-1.1 with its core engine in a private mirror (crates.io is an installer stub)
- Zero head-to-head TPC-H, ClickBench, or YCSB benchmarks vs DuckDB, ClickHouse, or PostgreSQL are claimed here

Signed Provenance · Self-Checked (human_in_gate=false; not peer-reviewed):
- Evidence: [E]/[M]/[S] · WAI1 blake3:74a6c924643a...
- Verification: https://blog.openie.dev/verification/
